description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Regulations for payment of fuel & telephone allowances for members of Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes regulations for payment of fuel and telephone allowances for members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government institutions). It deals specifically with public service conditions and benefits for local government officials, including allowance structures and payment criteria based on institutional revenue levels. This falls under Public Service Gazettes as it concerns compensation and benefits for public sector officials at the local government level.
